content:
On June 28, an Innovation Talk was held on the “Digital Transformation Plan of the AEC Sector – Architecture, Engineering, and Construction”, an event promoted by ANI.

The initiative, which took place online, featured luís Gomes and António Aguiar Costa, Vice President and Director of R&D at BUILT CoLAB respectively, who had the opportunity to address how digitization has been transforming the way we interact.

The focus of the conversation was on how “digital” will be a key lever for economic growth Portuguese and a challenge of reinvention of many economic fields and activities, but one that presents opportunities of greater market reach, with particular emphasis on the AEC sector.

Also present was Fernando Batista, President of IMPIC – Institute of Public Markets, Real Estate and Construction, and the moderation was Alexandre Almeida, Coordinator of the Strategy for Intelligent Specialization of ANI.

You can watch the video of the event here.

We recall that ANI’s Innovation Talks have as main objective to promote dialogue around the main challenges of today and demonstrate the importance of innovation as a driver of economic and social growth.
